companyFieldUpdates.description: Sunstone Power is a Mexican utility-scale renewable-development platform focused on large solar, wind and battery-storage projects. Its active legal entity, SUNSTONE POWER S DE RL DE CV, was formed on November 2, 2022. The company states that it is fully owned by Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners through Copenhagen Infrastructure New Markets Fund I. The intermediate Mexican shareholder chain and CIP's platform entry date are not publicly disclosed. CI Growth Markets Fund II is documented at the La Esperanza Solar project layer rather than as the platform owner, and Sunstone Power 2 and La Alegría remain nested affiliate and project records.
